messages:
Maria P.: FYI — overnight spike: ap-southeast-1 GPU spend jumped ~3.2x between 02:10–03:05 UTC. Alert came from the cost pipeline. Looks tied to a customer pilot (Riverton) but some usage shows 'sandbox' owner. Can someone check attribution? :thinking:

Jon S.: Looking now. I see a large number of short-lived spot instances from our Dedicated pool that map to customer=Riverton in telemetry, but billing tags for `owner_team` are null for ~40% of those runs. Possibly the rollout used an older agent that didn't set the new billing labels.

Kevin L.: @Jon S. yep — we rolled an agent change last week that added billing.label=team_id but the rollback for a canary left some hosts on the older image. Those hosts default to sandbox. I'll pull a sample of instance IDs and push a re-tagging job.

billing-bot: Automated alert — Cost anomaly detected: region=ap-southeast-1, service=gpu, change=+320%, window=55m, likely root=unlabeled-dedicated-pool. Ticket created: FIN-4532.

Liz O.: We need a quick decision: do we backcharge Riverton for the untagged portion or absorb to platform budget? Risk: customer billing for pilot has fixed cap; we promised to keep them under that cap.

Sam T.: Sharing the invoice fragment I pulled from the vendor — something weird with the SKU naming that might be why our ingestion didn't map it.

Sam T.: ```
Vendor invoice line: G-VM-SPOT-ASIA | sku_id: vs-asia-spot-23 | amount: 1,276.40 USD
Our meter name: redwood.gpu.spot.apa (expected)
Ingestion matched meter: redwood.gpu.spot (no region tag)
```

Maria P.: If ingestion dropped region tag, mapping to team becomes fuzzy. Proposal: 1) re-tag historical jobs that have telemetry linking to Riverton; 2) run a one-off backcharge for lines where we can prove customer usage; 3) absorb the remainder to platform for goodwill. Approve?

Liz O.: Approve steps 1 & 2. For step 3, let's cap platform absorption at $5k and escalate if >$5k. Please prepare an entry for the Monday finance review with numbers. :white_check_mark:

Kevin L.: I'll run the backfill script now. Command I will run:

```bash
# find instances with missing owner tag but correlated to customer metadata
python ops/scripts/backfill_billing_tags.py --since 2026-03-22T00:00Z --filter region=ap-southeast-1 --match metadata.customer=Riverton --set owner_team=riverton-team
```

Jon S.: After Kevin's backfill, I'll regenerate the cost attribution CSV and tag the affected charge IDs so Billing can apply customer credits.

Sam T.: One more thing — vendor invoice line items sometimes arrive with different sku_id forms. I'll open a mapping PR to normalize vendor_sku->internal_meter. Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/billing-mappings/pull/87

Liz O.: @Maria P., create a quick approval note in FIN-4532 documenting the $5k absorption cap and who signs off (Liz O.). I'll review the exported numbers before Monday.

Maria P.: Done — added note and next steps in FIN-4532. Thanks all. :pray:
